name: Ami AI
tagline: Lovable for getting customers
description: Most outbound dies on one decision: who to write to this week. Ami has already made it 17,707 times and kept score. Built on GPT-6 Astra and every one of those campaigns, it reads your website, picks the buyers who actually convert, and plans backwards from the number you need: leads, senders, weeks. If the list you asked for won't work, it says so before it builds anything. Approve the plan and it runs the outreach, watches every campaign, and fixes what slips. 19,854 booked meetings behind it.

name: AINA
tagline: Find your job search blind spots with an AI coach
description: AINA is an AI career coach that helps you see what's holding your job search back, strengthen your profile, and practice for interviews — through conversations with a video avatar. Talk to AINA and walk away with a personalized action plan for whatever's next in your career.

name: ProductBridge
tagline: AI-native customer support and feedback agent
description: Most teams run a helpdesk, a feedback board and a survey tool, then copy between them all week. ProductBridge is one system. An AI agent answers support chats from your help center, calls your APIs via tools, workflows and MCP, and hands off when it should. Every chat, survey and vote is captured, deduplicated and scored by reach and revenue, so your roadmap runs on evidence, not opinions. Ship it and everyone who asked is notified. MCP for Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor. Flat pricing, free plan.

name: MosMos
tagline: Voice writing that works before, during, and after meetings
description: MosMos goes beyond voice dictation by turning both individual thoughts and group conversations into usable writing. Speak naturally in any app, get fast and accurate text in the style you choose, or ask MosMos to search the web for current information. Its personal glossary remembers specialized terms after you add them once. In multi-speaker meetings, it tracks precise timestamps, distinguishes speakers, and creates structured notes, summaries, decisions, and action items for easier follow-up.

name: Sider Omni Sidebar
tagline: Give every Mac app an Agent Sidebar
description: An AI agent beside any Mac app. Sider Omni sidebar sees what's on your screen and acts on it directly, right where you're working. Watch the result, ask for the next change. Nothing to copy, nothing to upload. Built on GPT-6 Astra, and it can run on your existing ChatGPT or Codex credits.

name: Ari by Ariso
tagline: AI bar raiser for the most ambitious teams
description: The greatest companies like Amazon and Uber have long used “bar raisers” to grow their talent—and now you can too. Ari helps you and your team maintain and grow a higher standard of execution by handling the work about work, tracking commitments, reporting progress, aligning communications and priorities, driving follow-through, and showing what’s working so you can double down. You and everyone gains more time and mental space for meaningful work, to tackle your most ambitious projects.

name: Keysake
tagline: Learn English as you type Chinese
description: Learn English as you type Chinese. Keysake is a free macOS input method that shows English alongside your Chinese. Save words, phrases, or full sentences from what you want to say. Japanese, Korean, and more languages are coming soon.

name: Pushary
tagline: Every agent accessible via your Mac’s notch
description: Pushary Isle puts Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, VS Code and OpenCode in your Mac’s notch. Approve with one key, jump to the right terminal, or answer from your phone when you walk away. Native, 8 MB to download, 38 MB at rest, measured.

name: Nepotism Network
tagline: Great things start by knowing friend of a friend of a friend
description: Someone you know knows someone you wish you knew. Nepo Network maps these connections between you and the people you want to reach on X, uncovering potential paths to a warm intro. Explore ranked routes, see who connects each step, draft your ask, and track your outreach. Your network has a surprisingly useful extended family.

name: Makersclaw 2.0
tagline: The operating system for a company run by agents
description: MakersClaw 2.0 turns a goal into the apps, agents and automations needed to get it done. We originally launched MakersClaw as AI employees that lived in Slack, Teams and Telegram. We rebuilt it around a different idea: instead of hiring an agent for a role, tell MakersClaw what you want done. It builds the tools for the job, runs them continuously, remembers the work and operates within a budget you set. Today it starts with go-to-market

name: ApplySeed
tagline: Raise your seed from accelerators
description: Raise money from accelerators and programs that give you a clear Yes or NO, instead of another “let’s keep in touch.” Bring what you already have: a deck, your notes, or use our prompt with ChatGPT to generate your startup info. ApplySeed tells you what’s missing, finds programs you qualify for, and adapts your information to each application form. We fill it, you review and send it.

name: Toone
tagline: Build complex, reliable AI agent workflows & routines
description: Build, run and debug long-running or complex workflows in natural language. Inspect and debug each step with the visibility and control production workflows need. Edit and resume where you stopped. OpenAI or Anthropic accounts needed Predictable and deterministic AI: Craft workflows and routines with the consistency and observability needed for production, with multimodality supported between steps. Tip: Use ChatGPT desktop for ++ awesomeness Start building your routines today at trytoone.com

name: citizen404
tagline: The AGI runs the world with GPT-6 Astra. Hunt citizen404!
description: One citizen has escaped the Supreme AGI. Take the oath, hunt them across the open web, and find out why they noticed you. citizen404 is a multiplayer manhunt run by GPT-6 Astra. The Clerk emails you a case; its clues are hidden on real websites. Visit each dead drop, file what you find, and earn a piece of the line citizen404 left in chalk. Reorder the words to close the file. They always escape. What changes is how much they noticed you. No accounts: your email is the save file.

name: Maaa
tagline: A mom in your Mac’s notch, looking out for you
description: Meet Maaa, a familiar face in your Mac’s notch. Gentle reminders to drink water, eat and take a break, in 12 languages. For macOS 14 and later.

name: cubicles.lol
tagline: A metaverse for builders, side projects, and bad driving
description: Give your project a place people can walk into. Claim a cubicle, customize your space, and meet the builders next door. Race cars, go fishing, or grab a skateboard when you need a break. A multiplayer metaverse built with GPT-6 Astra. Free to explore in your browser. No download or account needed.

name: Edgee Codex Compressor V2
tagline: Use Codex at 35.6% lower costs
description: We benchmarked Codex alone against Codex routed through Edgee's compression gateway on the same repo, with the same model, under the same workflow. The result: Codex + Edgee used 49.5% fewer input tokens, improved cache hit rate from 76.1% to 85.4%, and reduced total session cost by 35.6%. This post breaks down why context compression makes Codex more efficient, more frugal, and materially cheaper to run without sacrificing useful output.

name: Bring Them to Life
tagline: Bring your product to life with friendly animations.
description: Bring Them to Life helps builders make their apps feel welcoming, memorable, and personal. Turn your own mascot into expressive moments without learning animation software or piecing together AI tools. Choose from 12 reactions and get transparent WebP, Lottie, and PNG animations you can reuse again and again in any background or scenario, mobile app, web app or desktop app. Bring your own artwork or create a new mascot. Get started today with as little as $1.

name: Mola
tagline: Build your café, hire a team, and grow a coffee chain
description: Mola is a cozy 3D café tycoon for Android. Serve customers, hire baristas and cleaners, arrange furniture, and expand across three districts. As your café gets busier, balance queues, stock, seating, and staff. Built with GPT-6 Astra through a player-directed process: describe an idea, play the build, and refine what happens. Free to play with optional purchases. Available in English and Turkish.

name: WhaleRead
tagline: Locally translate TXT, Markdown, and EPUB
description: WhaleRead is a local-first macOS reader that translates TXT, Markdown, and EPUB with on-device 7B or self-hosted 30B private models, preserves bilingual reading, and adds human-confirmed review plus Ask AI—while keeping your library under your control.

name: GameToMac
tagline: Play Windows games on Mac with AI-powered compatibility
description: GameToMac makes Windows games playable on Apple Silicon with smooth performance and high FPS. Built with GPT-6 Astra, it already supports Age of Empires IV, Age of Empires II, Company of Heroes 3, Counter-Strike 2, Overwatch, Red Alert 2, and Generals: Zero Hour. Thousands more Windows games will become playable on Mac very soon. Mac gaming is finally becoming a reality.
